description: A state-variable filter and a bank of tuned resonators fed from the same input, with a knob to blend between the two

params.text: Sets the frequency of both the filter and the resonators, 20Hz at the counter-clockwise end and 18000Hz at the clockwise end; while a cable is in the 1V/OCT input this knob is not read at all
Scales the voltage at the FM input, one octave per volt at the clockwise end, nothing at the centre and inverted counter-clockwise
Sweeps the filter from low pass through band pass to high pass
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the MORPH input before it is added to the MORPH knob
Sets the filter resonance, a Q of 0.5 at the counter-clockwise end and 15 at the clockwise end
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the RESO input before it is added to the RESO knob
Chooses the resonator's partial series and fades between neighbours in it: harmonic string, odd-harmonic tube, stiff string, tuned bar, free-free bar, circular membrane, square membrane, bell, plate
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the MODEL input before it is added to the MODEL knob
Sets how long the resonators ring after the input stops, from 0.05 seconds at the counter-clockwise end to 5 seconds at the clockwise end, measured as the time to fall 60dB
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the DECAY input before it is added to the DECAY knob
Crossfades the output between the state-variable filter and the resonator bank

inputs.text: The audio input, which feeds the filter and the resonators together
Sets the frequency of the filter and the resonators at one volt per octave from C4 at 261.63Hz, and while a cable is here the CUTOFF knob is ignored
Modulates the frequency in octaves per volt, scaled by the FM knob
Moves the filter between low pass and high pass, scaled by its attenuverter, with 5V covering the whole of the MORPH knob's travel
Modulates the resonance, scaled by its attenuverter, with 5V covering the whole of the RESO knob's travel
Moves the choice of resonator model, scaled by its attenuverter, with 5V covering the whole of the MODEL knob's travel
Modulates the ring time, scaled by its attenuverter, with 5V covering the whole of the DECAY knob's travel

outputs.text: The filter and resonator mix, five times the internal signal level and clipped at 10V

notes: a Modal Filter Expander placed immediately to the right adds five more resonator voices, each tuned away from this module's frequency
menu: Partials: Low (6), Mid (12), High (24), Full (32) — sets how many partials each resonator computes, which is how bright and how costly it is; the module starts on Mid
